title.narrative: Investing to achieve impact against HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria in Mauritania - Mauritania (01-Jul-2019-31-Dec-2021)

description.narrative: Mauritania, Multicomponent, National Executive Secretariat for the Fight Against AIDS of the Islamic Republic of Mauritania (SENLS Mauritania)This program has the following goals: Set up a solid base in reaching the 90-90-90 in 2020 and eliminating the epidemics in 2030.. Significantly reduce the burden of TB in Mauritania by 2023 in line with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and those set by WHO's new End TB Strategy.. Contribute to attaining the objective of eliminating malaria by 2025. The objectives of this program are: 75% of new infections are alleviated. 70% of PLHIV receiving ART to achieve viral load suppression in 2021. To detect 15,023 cases of tuberculosis between 2019 and 2023. Successfully treat at least 90% of cases of tuberculosis by 2023.. To test for HIV in 95% of reported tuberculosis cases by 2023.. Successfully treat 90% of TB/HIV infections by 2023. To reduce malaria incidence to less than 1 case per 1000 people in moughataas (districts) where there is a low rate of transmission. To halt indigenous transmission of malaria in the Strata I moughataas (districts) by 2018
